title: Filled star under tagged players
summary: Draw an opaque white five-point star with a near-black edge at every active tagged player’s feet.
input_constraints: Pinned USA retail, exact beta-58..64 star patch, or current filled renderer; mixed and foreign bytes refuse before writing.
Record +0x53 bit 0 through entity +0x3C. Up to 22 active entities; no roster-tag quota.
Common live indicator pass preserves HUD, coach and replay-camera gates. Recorded replay packets do not serialize the added stars.
portme: Witness the filled shape in a game and practice, bright turf/yard lines, HUD off, coach camera, replay and a tagged franchise roster.

gui.reason: ADVANCED; existing Basic off, Advanced and Experimental on. Filled replaces Outline under the existing player_star option. In-game appearance unwitnessed.

runtime.scope: Native queue, decoder, model selection, tag walk, material copy and vertex writes executed with bounded service/GPU stubs; no rasterization or played-mode witness.

fields.name: player_star
fields.allowed: boolean; false in Basic, true in Advanced and Experimental

fields.name: player_tags
fields.allowed: existing Rosters star selection; unchanged tag writer

selectors.notes: No style selector. MyCareer creation/signing tag assignment belongs to the separate runtime job.

source_container.resource: Frame call 0x64F21 and the same five pinned star spans (474 bytes total)

public_distribution.rule: Ship source, authored geometry and proof metadata; no retail executable or disc.
